turns.text: I also do this thing with present simple, present perfect.
turns.zh: 我还会讲这个，关于一般现在时和现在完成时的。

turns.text: "I'm studying French." "I've been on this course for six months." "I have been on this course for six months." "I'm studying." And then you kind of go back in time.
turns.zh: 「I'm studying French.」「I've been on this course for six months.」「I have been on this course for six months.」「I'm studying.」然后你就有点往回倒时间了。

turns.text: "I started six months ago until now." "I've been," contraction, "I've been on this course for six months."
turns.zh: 「I started six months ago until now.」「I've been」，缩写，「I've been on this course for six months.」

turns.text: Also, I do something here about adding information.
turns.zh: 还有，我在这里会讲一点关于补充信息的内容。

turns.text: Last time, I talked about adding information.
Here, we do it particularly with a relative clause, right?
turns.zh: 这里我们特别用关系从句来做，对吧？
